_Are you skilled at turning financial information into a clear performance story? Can you move confidently from the detail behind the numbers to the insights that matter most? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment with senior stakeholder exposure?

_The Group FP&A function owns and steers the financial performance of Pandora. The function plays a vital role in defining and enforcing the global performance management framework and policies across Global Finance and within the business – including being the driver of planning, budgeting and forecasting, defining KPIs and management reporting to the CFO and CEO. The function is therefore key to Pandora’s ability to provide the right guidance on expected future performance to the capital markets.

As Senior Manager, FP&A Reporting, you will play a key role in Pandora’s Group performance reporting, translating financial results and underlying business drivers into clear, decision-relevant insights for the CFO and CEO.

You will play a key role in the end-to-end performance reporting cycle, turning performance trends and underlying drivers into sharp insights, recommendations and actions. Working closely with Group Reporting & Accounting, Group Commercial Finance and stakeholders across Pandora, you will combine strong financial foundations with sound business judgement to turn complexity into clarity.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Own and continuously develop Pandora’s end-to-end Group performance reporting, including clear and decision-relevant commentary.

• Lead the preparation of the monthly and quarterly Group Business Performance Reviews and closing reviews delivering a high-quality reporting pack that clearly highlights key results, business drivers, risks and opportunities.

• Prepare executive and Board reporting, translating financial information into concise, actionable insights.

• Coordinate FP&A activities related to monthly, quarterly and annual closing in close partnership with Group Reporting & Accounting and other Finance teams.

• Analyze performance against budget, forecast and prior periods, including key drivers across revenue, gross margin, costs and cash flow.

• Play a key role in the governance and reporting of like-for-like performance, including system logic and definitions, ensuring LFL is consistently applied as a key performance measure.

• Serve as the centre of excellence for Group reporting methodology and the management reporting package, ensuring one set of numbers

• Partner with our Global Cost Transformation office on reporting and follow-up of initiatives and financial benefits.

• Continuously improve the structure, content and quality of Group performance reporting and commentary, driving simplification, standardization and automation across reporting processes and ways of working.

**What We’re Looking For

**You are a business-minded finance professional with a strong technical foundations and the ability to turn detailed analysis into a compelling executive-level performance story.

**What You Bring

**

• Relevant experience from a similar role within Group Finance, FP&A or controlling in a larger international organization.

• A robust accounting foundation and a solid understanding of the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow, including working capital.

• Experience with monthly closing, Group consolidation, management reporting and performance-review processes.

• Proven ability to translate financial results into clear, concise insights for CFO and/or Board-level audiences.

• Sound business acumen and judgement, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and focus on what matters most.

• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders at all levels.

• A proactive mindset, anticipating needs and raising issues and opportunities early rather than simply reacting to requests.

• A track record of improving, simplifying or automating finance and reporting processes, supported by advanced systems, Excel and PowerPoint skills.

• Comfort working in a complex international environment with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

**Additional Information

**

• Career Band 4A

**Did we get your attention?

**If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible.

You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Recognised by the Financial Times as one of Europe’s Best Workplaces and ranked #1 among Danish companies, Pandora is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workplace. We believe that reflecting the diversity of society in how we engage with our customers is essential to fulfilling our purpose: to give a voice to people’s loves. We are dedicated to nurturing a culture where everyone feels respected, valued.

**The Impact You'll Make

**The future of Sales and Customer Service will not be built by simply digitizing today's processes - it will be shaped by people who rethink how work gets done.

As our Forward Deployed AI Solution Engineer, you'll work closely with Sales and Customer Service teams to identify high-impact opportunities and turn AI, automation, and digital technologies into practical solutions that improve how we work.

This role is for a curious problem-solver who enjoys challenging the status quo, experimenting with emerging technologies, and creating measurable business value. Your impact will be seen through improved productivity, better decision-making, stronger adoption, and enhanced experiences for employees and customers.

From AI copilots and intelligent automation to digital workflows and data-driven insights, you'll help shape the future of how Sales and Customer Service teams work at Danfoss Climate Solutions.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Serve as the AI and Digital Transformation lead for your commercial domain (Sales or Customer Service), driving adoption of innovative technologies and new ways of working.

• Identify and deliver opportunities that reduce manual effort, simplify processes, increase productivity, and create better experiences for employees and customers.

• Inspire stakeholders by demonstrating what is possible with AI, helping teams move from experimentation to business value.

• Evaluate business impact by measuring adoption, efficiency gains, and user feedback, ensuring solutions deliver real value.

• Capture best practices and reusable solution patterns that help accelerate AI adoption across commercial functions.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Someone to constantly challenge "the way we've always done it" and help unlock entirely new ways of working through AI, automation, and data-driven decision making.

• At least 3 years of experience in sales or customer excellence, project management, solution engineering, technical consulting, digital transformation, automation, AI enablement, or a similar hands-on role.

• Experience working closely with business stakeholders and translating business problems into practical digital or AI-enabled solutions.

• Strong understanding of commercial processes such as sales operations, customer support, pricing, quotations, CRM, or product data management.

• An advantage if experience with modern digital technologies such as APIs, automation platforms, AI solutions, low-code tools, SQL, Python, or similar technologies.

• Strong analytical thinking, excellent English communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across business and engineering teams.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• Shape the future of commercial operational excellence by using AI and digital technologies to solve meaningful business challenges with real, measurable impact.

• Grow your career through continuous learning, exposure to emerging AI technologies, and collaboration with global experts across Sales, Customer Service, Digital, Data, and AI.

• Enjoy the autonomy to experiment, innovate, and bring your ideas to life in an environment that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous improvement.

• Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture where diverse perspectives are valued, knowledge is shared, and teams succeed together across functions and borders.

• Receive the flexibility and support to do your best work, helping you balance professional growth with your wellbeing while making a meaningful difference.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

About ChemoMetec

ChemoMetec is a worldwide leading manufacturer of cell counting and analysis equipment. We specialize in developing and producing high-precision instrumentation, delivering consistent data for thousands of customers across biotech, pharma, and academic segments.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized and scientifically skilled Product Specialist - Technical Support & Documentation to lead technical support for ChemoMetec’s portfolio of analytical cell-counting instruments. In this support-centered role, you will handle technical inquiries from both customers and colleagues and act as the go-to reference for technically accurate and compliant solutions. The role combines life science, technical documentation, and QA collaboration, making it ideal for someone with a strong scientific background and a passion for structured problem-solving.

We are hiring two Product Specialists for our technical support team: one focused on documentation and one on data analysis. You will be part of the Product Management Department and work closely with QA, Field Application Scientists, and product teams to resolve customer complaints, complete technical documentation, and maintain our support infrastructure. A solid foundation in mathematics and validation methodologies, along with a strong understanding of GMP regulatory requirements, is essential to succeed in this role.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide technical support across all instrument platforms, with a focus on structured problem-solving and documentation.

• Collaborate with QA to complete technical questionnaires and support the resolution of customer complaints.

• Maintain and organize our support database platform, ensuring technical records are accurate and accessible.

• Proofread and write technical notes, user guides, and comparison studies.

• Develop and implement procedures to support both existing and new products.

• Ensure all support activities comply with GMP and relevant quality standards.

• Act as a subject matter expert on instrumentation and scientific applications, providing technical insight to internal teams.

Your Profile

• PhD in Biology, Physics, or a related scientific discipline.

• Solid foundation in mathematics and validation methodologies, and a strong understanding of GMP regulatory requirements.

• Strong understanding of microscopy, analytical instrumentation, and pharmaceutical workflows.

• Highly organized, structured, and detail-oriented.

• Excellent written communication skills, with experience producing technical documentation.

• Familiarity with support platforms or ticketing systems is a plus.

• Comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, technical environment.

Why join ChemoMetec?

At ChemoMetec, we believe that great people make a great workplace. We value both personal and professional development and offer an environment where you can grow, take responsibility, and make an impact. You will become part of a team of talented and supportive colleagues who enjoy working together in an informal and welcoming atmosphere. We also believe that strong relationships go beyond the workplace, which is why we regularly bring colleagues together through company-wide events to build connections and strengthen relationships across the organization.

Practical information

Both positions are on-site at our HQ in Allerød, Denmark. You will refer to Director, Ph.D. Product Management Bassam Tawfik.

Starting date is as soon as possible, and we conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. Deadline for applying is 20 November 2026.

If you have any further questions about this job opportunity, feel free to contact Frederikke Hvidberg, fhv@chemometec.com

Senior Strategy Manager – Strategic Programme Office, VELUX Products & Innovation - Østbirk

Join a strategically important programme at the heart of the VELUX Group. If you thrive on bringing clarity to complexity, influencing senior stakeholders, and driving progress across large-scale business initiatives, this could be your opportunity to make an impact while working with executive leadership.

Meet your future team

You will join the Strategic Programme Office within Products & Innovation, where we support the successful execution of strategically important initiatives across the VELUX Group. We work closely with Executive Group Management, senior leaders, and specialists from across the organisation to ensure strong governance, informed decision-making, and successful delivery of business-critical programmes.

As part of a collaborative and international environment, you will help create alignment across diverse stakeholder groups and contribute to transforming strategic ambitions into tangible results. The role offers significant exposure to senior leadership and the opportunity to influence key decisions that shape the future of the business.

What We Offer

In this role, you will play a central part in driving governance, decision-making and execution within a complex, cross-functional programme. You will have the opportunity to work across strategic, commercial, financial and operational dimensions while partnering with leaders across the organisation.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

• Drive the programme governance cycle, including preparation for Steering Committee, Executive Group Management and Board of Directors meetings.

• Prepare agendas, pre-reads, decision materials, decision logs and follow-up actions.

• Develop clear, compelling and decision-oriented materials and recommendations for senior leadership.

• Consolidate and structure input from multiple functions and translate it into fact-based recommendations and decision proposals.

• Maintain the integrated programme plan, including key deliverables, critical decision points and cross-functional dependencies.

• Ensure systematic follow-up on executive decisions, conditions and actions.

• Support reporting of programme status, risks, issues and required decisions.

• Collaborate closely with Group Finance on the programme business case, financial assumptions and financial steering.

• Maintain transparency around risks, issues and actions, ensuring timely escalation when decisions are required.

• Coordinate and collaborate with stakeholders across Sales & Marketing, Product Management, R&D, Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement and Strategy & Execution.

• Support the continuous development and professionalisation of programme management and governance practices within Products & Innovation.

What You Will Bring

You are an analytical and structured professional who enjoys creating alignment, momentum and clarity in complex environments. You combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach and are confident engaging with senior stakeholders while fostering strong cross-functional collaboration.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Have 3-6 years of experience from a leading strategy consulting firm or a strategy, transformation or programme management role within a larger international organisation.

• Hold a relevant higher education degree.

• Have experience supporting governance structures or programme offices for complex, cross-functional initiatives involving senior executives.

• Bring strong capabilities in structured problem-solving, analytical thinking, stakeholder management and executive communication.

• Have experience within negotiation, change management and organisational alignment.

• Possess a solid understanding of business cases and the financial logic underpinning strategic decisions.

• Can translate complex and technical topics into concise and impactful communication for senior leadership.

• Are comfortable operating between strategic direction and operational execution.

• Communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken.

• Thrive when driving progress through collaboration and influence rather than formal authority.

• Value teamwork and actively contribute to an inclusive, constructive and high-performing culture.

Ready to apply?

Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

About VELUX

In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, “courage” and “mutual respect” define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At VELUX Residential, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop, and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected, and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all, whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX Residential.

That means we recruit, hire, train, and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

Are you a hands-on Marketing Automation Manager who enjoys turning customer data into personalised experiences and measurable business results?

At Scandlines, you will take ownership of developing our marketing automation capabilities across B2C and B2B, combining technical expertise with a commercial mindset to improve customer engagement, retention, and growth.

**Job Description

**As part of our E-commerce & Digital Transformation team, you will drive the development and optimisation of our marketing automation activities.

You will work hands-on in Bloomreach (CDP & Marketing Automation) and HubSpot (CRM), designing and optimising automated customer journeys, activating customer data, and identifying new opportunities to improve customer experiences and commercial performance. Email content and production are handled by colleagues, allowing you to focus on marketing automation, segmentation, and personalisation.

You will also take ownership of our marketing automation roadmap, prioritising initiatives based on customer needs, business impact, and available resources.

The role involves close collaboration with colleagues across E-commerce, Marketing, IT, and external partners.

Area of responsiblities

• Own and develop the marketing automation roadmap, prioritising customer journeys and commercial impact across B2C and B2B.

• Design and optimise personalised, automated customer journeys in Bloomreach and HubSpot to drive engagement, retention, and repeat bookings.

• Activate customer data through segmentation and behavioural triggers to improve customer journeys across email, app, sms, website, and MyScandlines.

• Analyse customer behaviour and journey performance, using reporting and A/B testing to improve results.

• Maintain customer data quality, support integrations, and collaborate with internal stakeholders and external agencies to develop and implement automated customer journeys.

Competencies

You are an experienced marketing automation professional who combines strong technical skills with an analytical and commercial mindset.

You enjoy working directly in the platforms, but you also see the bigger picture and take responsibility for driving initiatives forward.

**We Expect That You

**

• Have 4+ years of hands-on experience with marketing automation or CRM, either in-house or at an agency.

• Have solid experience with Bloomreach or similar platforms, such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze, or Iterable.

• Ideally have experience with HubSpot, although this is not a requirement.

• Have strong experience with automated customer journeys, advanced segmentation, personalisation, and lifecycle marketing.

• Are comfortable working with customer data, reporting, performance metrics, and A/B testing.

• Understand CRM structures, workflows, lead management, and customer data integration.

• Have technical knowledge of HTML/CSS, email deliverability, and privacy regulations such as GDPR.

• Have a commercial mindset and can translate customer insights into initiatives that improve conversion, retention, and customer value.

• Experience from travel, e-commerce, or subscription-based businesses is an advantage.

Personal skills

You are proactive, structured, and solution-oriented, with a natural ability to take ownership and drive initiatives forward.

You enjoy collaborating across teams, challenging existing ways of working, and identifying opportunities for improvement.

Most importantly, you combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach and are motivated by turning ideas into meaningful results.

Additional information

Additional information

**What We Offer

**We offer an exciting and challenging role in a dynamic, international organisation with high ambitions. You will join a digital and commercial team of dedicated colleagues in an informal working environment.

The role is based at our Copenhagen office (Havneholmen).

We offer a competitive salary based on your qualifications, along with a range of attractive employee benefits, including a pension scheme, health insurance, a staff canteen, additional days off, and various discount schemes.

Join a leading international life science company in an exciting role and assume end-to-end responsibility for a high-impact role at the intersection of operational strategy and execution.

Lead a Complex Global Clinical Study with strategic impact

As Clinical Trial Program Lead, you will play a key role in shaping and executing the company’ clinical development strategy. Reporting to the Head of Clinical Operations, you will assume responsibility for a strategically important Global Clinical Study while influencing the future direction of the company’s development portfolio.

Operating in an outsourced model, you will provide strategic oversight of CROs and external partners, ensuring clinical programs are delivered to the highest standards of quality, compliance, timelines, and budget. You will serve as a trusted partner to senior stakeholders, driving cross-functional decision-making, managing program risks, and translating development objectives into successful execution.

Beyond study delivery, you will contribute to lifecycle management, portfolio development, and the evaluation of future business opportunities, combining scientific insight, business acumen, and operational excellence to create long-term value. This is a highly visible role offering a rare combination of strategic influence, broad organizational exposure, and ownership of complex global development activities.

Global Clinical Study Leadership in an outsourced setup

You bring extensive experience from the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry and a proven track record of leading complex global clinical development programs. Operating in fully outsourced environments, you have successfully provided strategic oversight of CROs and external partners while maintaining accountability for quality, timelines, budgets, and study outcomes.

You combine a strong understanding of clinical development, global regulatory requirements, and ICH-GCP with the ability to translate scientific and business objectives into executable strategies. With sound business acumen and a strategic mindset, you are comfortable influencing senior stakeholders, navigating complex matrix organizations, and driving cross-functional decisions that create value and accelerate delivery.

Personally, you thrive in environments characterized by complexity, accountability, and change. You balance strategic perspective with operational pragmatism, bringing sound judgment, resilience, and a strong sense of ownership to everything you do. Through credibility and collaboration, you create alignment across stakeholders and build momentum around shared objectives.

Most importantly, you are motivated by shaping the direction of clinical development programs, challenging established thinking, and delivering meaningful outcomes for patients, the business, and the broader development portfolio.

Become Part of an Ambitious Growth Journey

This is an opportunity to join an international and innovation-driven life science organization at an exciting stage of development. You will have significant influence on critical clinical studies and work closely with senior stakeholders across the business, helping to shape future development activities and strategic priorities. The recruitment process is carried out by Venaris Executive Search. For more information regarding the position, please reach out to Sr. Executive Search Consultant, Lars Nordlund, on +45 3123 3018. All requests will be handled confidentially. If this position is for you, do not hesitate to apply by uploading your CV - it is not necessary to include a cover letter.

Restaurant Manager (Restaurantchef)

📍 Solrød Strand, Denmark | Full-Time | Permanent Position

Join Gastronomia Smeralda as Our Next Restaurant Manager

Gastronomia Smeralda is seeking an experienced and dedicated Restaurant Manager to lead our restaurant operations in Solrød Strand. We are looking for a dynamic professional who can ensure exceptional guest experiences, maintain high operational standards, and support the continued growth of our business.

About the Position

As Restaurant Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the restaurant, managing staff, maintaining service quality, and ensuring efficient business performance. This is a full-time management position offering significant responsibility and opportunities for professional development.

Key Responsibilities

● Lead and coordinate daily front-of-house and back-of-house operations.

● Supervise, train, motivate, and evaluate restaurant staff.

● Prepare employee schedules and manage workforce planning.

● Monitor inventory levels, purchasing, and cost control.

● Ensure compliance with Danish food safety, hygiene, and health regulations.

● Maintain high standards of food quality, presentation, and customer service.

● Handle customer feedback and resolve guest concerns professionally.

● Assist with budgeting, financial monitoring, and operational reporting.

● Develop and implement marketing and promotional initiatives.

● Coordinate with suppliers, contractors, and relevant authorities.

● Support recruitment, onboarding, and employee development.

● Ensure restaurant facilities and equipment are properly maintained.

● Foster a positive, professional, and productive working environment.

Qualifications

We are looking for candidates who have:

● Experience in restaurant management, hospitality management, or a similar leadership role.

● Strong leadership and team-management skills.

● Excellent customer service and communication abilities.

● Knowledge of restaurant operations, inventory management, and cost control.

● Familiarity with food safety and hygiene regulations.

● Good organizational and problem-solving capabilities.

● Ability to work independently and make operational decisions.

● English proficiency; Danish language skills are considered an advantage.

Employment Terms

● Position: Restaurant Manager (Restaurantchef)

● Location: Solrød Strandvej 66, 2680 Solrød Strand, Denmark

● Working Hours: 37 hours per week

● Employment Type: Full-time, permanent employment

● Salary: Salary according to qualifications.

What We Offer

● Competitive salary package.

● Permanent employment in a growing restaurant business.

● Opportunity to lead and influence restaurant operations.

● Professional and supportive working environment.

● Career development opportunities within hospitality management.

Application

Interested candidates are encouraged to submit their CV and relevant documentation. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position will be filled as soon as the right candidate is found.

Application Deadline: 30 November 2026

Send your Application and CV to the email: smrd.solrod@outlook.com

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til: smrd.solrod@outlook.com

North Indian Cook for Indian Restaurant

Pippali Indian Grill is looking for an experienced North Indian Cook

Pippali Indian Grill is an Indian restaurant serving authentic Indian food with a focus on quality, flavour and traditional cooking methods. We are looking for a skilled and reliable cook with experience in North Indian cuisine to join our kitchen team.

As our new cook, you will be responsible for preparing and cooking Indian dishes, especially North Indian specialities such as curries, tandoori dishes, marinades, sauces, biryani and traditional vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes. You will help ensure that our food is prepared consistently, hygienically and to a high standard.

Your main tasks will include:
Preparing and cooking authentic North Indian dishes
Preparing marinades, sauces, curries and spice mixes
Working with tandoor, grill and traditional Indian cooking techniques
Ensuring good food quality, taste and presentation
Maintaining hygiene and food safety standards in the kitchen
Helping with daily kitchen preparation and cleaning
Cooperating with the rest of the kitchen and restaurant team

We expect that you:
Have relevant culinary education or equivalent documented professional experience as a cook
Have experience with North Indian cuisine, preferably from an Indian restaurant kitchen
Have strong knowledge of Indian spices, ingredients, marinades and traditional cooking methods
Can prepare North Indian dishes independently and consistently
Can work with tandoor, grill, curry preparation and other Indian kitchen techniques
Can work independently and handle a busy kitchen environment
Are reliable, flexible and quality-conscious
Can follow hygiene and food safety procedures
Can communicate in English. Danish is an advantage but not required.

Documentation of qualifications
Applicants should be able to document their professional background through relevant certificates, employment references, recommendation letters, previous employment records or other documentation showing education and/or practical experience as a cook.

We offer:
A full-time position in an Indian restaurant
A workplace with focus on authentic food and good service
A friendly and professional working environment
The opportunity to use your experience with Indian cuisine in Denmark
Salary according to qualifications and agreement
Employment terms according to Danish standards

Indian Tandoor Chef for Pippali Indian Grill

Pippali Indian Grill is looking for an experienced Indian Tandoor Chef to join our kitchen team.

Pippali Indian Grill is an Indian restaurant dedicated to serving authentic Indian cuisine with a strong focus on quality, flavour and traditional cooking techniques.

We are looking for a skilled, experienced and reliable Indian Tandoor Chef who specialises in traditional North Indian tandoori cooking, including preparing and cooking dishes in a clay tandoor oven.

As our new Tandoor Chef, you will be responsible for preparing authentic Indian tandoori specialities, including tandoori chicken, chicken tikka, seekh kebabs, naan, roti and other traditional vegetarian and non-vegetarian tandoori dishes. You will play an important role in maintaining the authenticity, consistency and high quality of our food.

Your main tasks will include:

• 
Preparing and cooking authentic North Indian tandoori dishes using a traditional clay tandoor oven

• 
Preparing and baking Indian breads, including naan, garlic naan, butter naan and tandoori roti

• 
Preparing traditional tandoori specialities such as chicken tikka, tandoori chicken, seekh kebabs, paneer tikka and other grilled dishes

• 
Preparing authentic Indian marinades, spice blends and seasoning mixtures

• 
Managing tandoor temperatures and ensuring proper cooking techniques

• 
Ensuring consistent food quality, flavour, texture and presentation

• 
Maintaining hygiene, food safety and cleanliness standards in the kitchen

jobs.occupation: Academic Coordinator for the EUROfusion Project
jobs.description:
SDU Center for Large Structure Production (LSP), part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI) at University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for one funded Academic Staff position, to be project administrator for the EUROfusion project. The temporary position will be vacant from 1 January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter, until 31 December 2027. Main work location is Odense/Denmark at SDU and Odense Havn (Odense Port).

Work environment

The candidate will be part of SDU Center for Large Structure Production (LSP). LSP’s central ambition is to provide a physical “go-to” lab for companies in the sectors maritime, construction and energy to carry out research, development, and testing of novel solutions in the production of large structures, such as buildings, ships and offshore platforms. In this context, the candidate is expected to work closely with our industrial partners on application-oriented use cases, while helping to commission and operate the unique set of equipment of the center. 

LSP is closely working together the companies at Odense Havn and similar partners making large structures across Denmark and Europe. LSP is integrated with the Odense Robotics Cluster involving startups and established companies in robotics. We are a team of currently about 24 researchers, engineers and PhD students, specialized in robot solutions involving modelling, simulation, and control of advanced robot technologies (systems and services) for application-oriented industrial applications. 

Our group is involved in a variety of national and European projects and features a strong network of academic and industrial partners. We solve challenging research problems derived from real-life challenges by implementing novel robot solutions. We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international team, with flexible work organization and support for individual development.

Job description

The candidate will be project administrator for the EUROfusion project. Jointly, and together with the rest of the team around this project, this goes for other institutes and departments of SDU TEK together with partners from ITER and EUROfusion. 

Profile and requirements

The candidate is expected to have the following qualifications:

• 
Good communication and collaborative skills

• 
Good English and Danish skills, both written and spoken

• 
Can work independently and have a good overview

• 
IT skills and being good at developing and maintaining procedures

• 
Background in engineering will be useful, e.g. involving handling of 3D models

Contact information

For further information, please contact Professor Christian Schlette via email (chsch@mmmi.sdu.dk) or on LinkedIn (www.linkedin.com/in/christian-schlette/).

Application deadline: November 30, 2026 at 23:59 o'clock. 

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

"Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.”

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out. 

You can only apply for the position at – https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu. 

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

Do you like to create structure, improving processes, and turning data into decisions?

At Original Coffee, we are looking for an analytical and structured Production & Supply Planner to strengthen our production planning across our bakery and coffee roastery.

This is a newly created position where you will have the opportunity to shape processes, improve efficiency, and ensure production aligns with demand while keeping inventory, costs, and resources under control.

You will work closely with our Production, Operations, Wholesale, and Finance teams, turning data and insights into practical improvements.

About us

Original Coffee (OC) is a growing company with 22 coffee shops around Copenhagen. We invite our guests to pause, refocus, and connect—both with themselves and with others. From the moment they walk through our doors, our mission is to create a memorable experience: freshly baked goods from our own bakery, exceptional coffee from our own roastery, and outstanding service. Together, that’s what we call the OC experience!

In OC it all starts with people – our guests, our team, and our partners. We believe that putting people first creates the foundation for strong communities, great experiences, and coffee worth coming back for!

Your responsibilities

As our Production & Supply Planner, you will help build a structured, data-driven approach to production planning.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Production planning: Develop and maintain production plans based on demand, sales, seasonality, and capacity.

• Forecasting: Analyze data and forecast future production needs.

• Inventory management: Monitor stock and optimize inventory.

• Cost calculations: Calculate and maintain accurate product costs in collaboration with our production and Finance.

• Process optimisation: Identify opportunities to reduce waste, improve productivity, and optimise resources.

• Data & reporting: Develop reports and analyses to support our business.

• Cross-functional collaboration: Coordinate planning across the bakery, roastery, logistics, and other departments.

You won't be responsible for managing daily production but will act as a key partner to our production teams, helping shape how we plan and improve our processes.

Who are you?

We imagine you have experience in production planning, supply chain, inventory management, or a similar field.

Ideally, you:

• Have 3 years experience with production planning, forecasting, or supply planning.

• Are analytical, structured, and confident working with numbers.

• Have strong Excel skills and preferably experience with ERP or planning systems.

• Understand inventory management, production costs, and cost calculations.

• Can turn data into actionable improvements.

• Take ownership, work independently, and enjoy collaborating across teams.

Experience in food production is an advantage, but what matters most is your analytical mindset and motivation to make things better.

What do we offer?

At Original Coffee, you'll join a passionate team dedicated to great coffee, quality products, and memorable experiences.

We offer:

• Create the role with the opportunity to make a real impact.

• The freedom to develop and improve processes.

• Close collaboration with dedicated colleagues across our bakery, roastery, and HQ.

• A role combining analysis, operations, and business development.

• An informal workplace with short decision-making processes and room for new ideas.

You will report to our CFO and work closely with our production teams and Finance.

Sounds like something for you?

We would love to hear from you!

**Specialist, Lifecycle Programs - CRM focused

**Do you want to build customer journeys that engage customers across their lifecycle?

We are looking for a hands-on lifecycle professional to help Pandora build, maintain and optimise automated customer programs in Bloomreach. As Specialist, Lifecycle Programs, you will translate approved strategies, briefs and playbooks into reliable CRM customer journeys in Bloomreach. You will work closely with the Lifecycle team, markets, Analytics, Digital & Technology and external partners to deliver high-quality lifecycle programs consistently and at scale.

**What You Will Do

**Together with the team, you will help turn our lifecycle strategy into high-quality, scalable customer experiences in Bloomreach. Your focus will be hands-on CRM implementation, quality execution and continuous optimisation.

**Build and deliver lifecycle programs

**

• Translate approved briefs and playbooks into segmentation, targeting and Bloomreach scenario setups.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Scientist for formulation and high throughput assay development
jobs.description:
Do you want to apply your skills within drug discovery and help turn new molecules into new drug products? We are looking for a motivated Scientist to support our drug discovery pipeline within Pharmaceutical Development in our Biotech unit at Gubra.

As our new Scientist, you will take ownership for physicochemical characterization of peptides including development and maintenance of our high throughput plate-based assays. You will be part of both our Pharmaceutical Development department and our cross-departmental drug discovery project teams contributing to study planning and data interpretation to progress our molecules through the discovery and development pipeline. You will work closely with scientists and laboratory technicians across Gubra.

Your new department

The Pharmaceutical Development department supports Gubra’s drug discovery & development projects by delivering physicochemical characterization, formulation development and analytical development and support for novel peptide drug candidates. Our department is involved all the way from early drug discovery, through to supporting Gubra’s CMC department when our projects go into clinical development. We are currently 5 scientists and 5 laboratory technicians in the department.

Key responsibilities

• Act as the Pharmaceutical Development lead scientist in drug discovery projects setting the scientific direction for designing, interpreting, and reporting studies from early drug discovery all the way to supporting clinical development.

• Responsible for setting up and developing new high-throughput plate-based assays to support discovery and development of new drug candidates.

• Evaluate physicochemical stability of peptides using high-throughput plate-based assays (fluorescence, UV, turbidity, DLS) and/or HPLC and MS.

• Drive early-stage formulation development for new drug candidates.

• Identify opportunities for automatization and optimization of our laboratory workflows and develop improvements in close collaboration with laboratory technicians and scientists.

Core competencies and qualifications

We imagine you have solid experience with and a strong interest in assay development for physicochemical characterization of peptides. You have knowledge and experience within early formulation development for peptides. You enjoy collaborating with laboratory technicians and scientists with different backgrounds and you thrive in a fast-paced environment.

• A PhD or master’s degree within biochemistry, chemistry, pharmaceutics, engineering, or similar.

• 3+ years relevant experience within drug discovery or development projects.

• Experience with different assay methods for peptides (fluorescence, UV, turbidity, DLS or others).

• Experience with coordination of laboratory tasks and close collaboration with laboratory technicians.

• Propose new scientific ideas, take initiative to move agreed work forward, and involve colleagues in developing and implementing improvements.

• Great execution and collaboration skills.

• Experience with communicating study plans, scientific findings and uncertainties clearly to scientists and laboratory technicians, adapting explanations to the audience and checking shared understanding.

As a person you are

• Keen to take on responsibility and take the lead.

• Proactive and good at initiating and delivering on new projects and following up on new ideas.

• Keen on collaborating across departmental workflows, sharing relevant knowledge and contributing to agreed priorities within your role and expertise.

• Able to adapt plans when priorities change, clarify expectations with colleagues and communicate the implications for ongoing work.

We offer

Gubra Biotech is a project-centric organization, and you will work in cross-functional teams on our drug discovery projects. As a Scientist representing Pharmaceutical Development, you will provide scientific recommendations within your discipline and agreed project priorities, working together with scientists from other study disciplines including Chemistry, Molecular Pharmacology, Translational Pharmacology, DMPK, and Computational Drug Discovery.

We are expanding our capabilities, and you will have the opportunity to impact what new methods and workflows that Pharmaceutical Development needs.

You will be supported to perform at your best, trusted to take ownership and encouraged to share your ideas, learn from colleagues and drive projects forward while growing professionally.

Contact and application

Please apply no later than November 29th, 2026, by uploading your motivated cover letter, resume and relevant diplomas on our website. Applications will be evaluated on a rolling basis.

If you have questions about the position, you are very welcome to contact Senior Department Manager Natashia Mai Yde Jacobsen at nyj@gubra.dk.

We are looking forward to receiving your application.

About Gubra

Gubra is a disease-agnostic techbio company specialized in peptide-based drug discovery and development as well as preclinical contract research services striving for excellence at all levels. We insist on doing things efficiently – and often differently - to reach the results we aim for. Our vision is to become leaders in the path towards a more sustainable and healthier world. We do that by facilitating the discovery of new medicine, and by acting and inspiring others to fight the ongoing climate and biodiversity crises.

Gubra’s activities are focused on the early stages of drug development and are organised in two main highly synergistic business areas: Biotech and CRO Services. We generate our revenue by performing research for life science companies as well as by partnering projects from our discovery and development pipeline.

Our therapeutic focus is within metabolic and fibrotic diseases, and we specialize in in vivo pharmacology, ex vivo assays, drug profiling, histology, stereology and whole brain and organ imaging. In addition, we offer a full palette of advanced transcriptomics. Our ML/AI-driven peptide drug discovery platform streaMLine enables us to rapidly develop a peptide hit into a non-clinical candidate ready for development. Through a constant focus on high quality, scientific excellence, speed, and solid teamwork we have established ourselves as a highly professional and competent partner in the market.

People are our greatest asset, and our team consists of around 300 employees of which many are located in Hørsholm, Denmark. The mix of people from different cultures and educational backgrounds combined with our entrepreneurial mindset have greatly impacted our working environment, which is characterized by entrepreneurial drive, scientific curiosity, and teamwork – we join forces!

**Your impact begins here

**As Senior Research Scientist – Discovery Pharmacology, you will help build a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research that generates and validates therapeutic concepts in cardiometabolic disease and healthspan. You will combine hands-on rodent pharmacology with original scientific thinking, shaping research questions and turning emerging biology into opportunities for drug discovery. Your work will bring new projects into the early discovery pipeline, because lasting health starts with the science we build today.

**What You Will Bring

**You hold a PhD in pharmacology, physiology, neuroscience or a related discipline, or bring equivalent relevant research experience. You also bring:

• At least two years of relevant post-PhD experience with scientific innovation, or equivalent scientific contributions.

• Hands-on experience in rodent pharmacology.

• Strong skills in experimental design, quantitative analysis and interpretation of complex biological data.

• Scientific depth in metabolic physiology, neuroscience, in vitro pharmacology, or a related area.

• Original scientific thinking, intellectual curiosity and the ability to turn ideas into testable hypotheses.

• A collaborative approach and the ability to work independently while contributing to shared research goals.

• Clear scientific communication in written and spoken English.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**Experience in metabolic phenotyping, advanced behavioural assays, rodent surgery, modern neuroscience methods, in vitro or ex vivo approaches, or developing novel experimental technologies. We welcome complementary profiles – you are not expected to bring expertise in every method or scientific area.

**What You Will Do

**You will contribute to both the scientific direction and hands-on experimental work of the team. Your responsibilities will include:

• Generate hypotheses and propose new therapeutic concepts grounded in biological understanding.

• Design, conduct, analyse and interpret mouse and rat pharmacology studies to investigate efficacy, mechanism of action and physiological responses.

• Develop experimental models and introduce methodologies that enable us to address challenging scientific questions.

• Connect in vivo findings with relevant in vitro and ex vivo experiments.

• Integrate evidence into recommendations on how emerging concepts should advance, change direction or be discontinued.

• Document and communicate findings, sharing scientific insights across disciplines and project teams.

• Contribute to rigorous, reproducible experimental practice and high standards of animal welfare.

All scientists are expected to contribute directly to experimental work alongside laboratory technicians and fellow scientists.

**Who You Will Work With

**You will join a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research within Research & Development, combining expertise in physiology, pharmacology, neuroscience and molecular innovation. Day to day, you will work closely with scientists and laboratory technicians. The team, headed by Christoffer Clemmensen, is currently recruiting at multiple levels, so you contribute to shape the new team from the onset.

You are expected to establish close collaborations across the organisation with colleagues in chemistry, biology, DMPK and relevant technology functions to develop and test new therapeutic concepts. Bringing these perspectives together early helps the team make clear, evidence-based decisions at pace.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will have the opportunity to shape the research of a new team and contribute your own ideas, in an environment that values thoughtful scientific challenge, collaboration and learning from unexpected findings.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000.00 to 956,900.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn emerging biology into new therapeutic concepts, apply for the Senior Research Scientist – Discovery Pharmacology role by 22 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.occupation: Head of P&O for Louis Nielsen
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about creating an exceptional employee experience and enabling business performance? Then this could be your next opportunity at Louis Nielsen and Specsavers.

Join us as our new Head of P&O for Louis Nielsen and take responsibility for a people agenda spanning two distinct parts of our business: our Support Office and our nationwide retail organisation. As a trusted business partner to the Country Leadership Team, you'll help shape organisational success by translating people priorities into meaningful business outcomes while leading a skilled, supportive and caring P&O team.

Your role

As Head of P&O, you will lead the local P&O team and people agenda for Louis Nielsen in Denmark. The role has two important dimensions.

For our Support Office, you will work closely with the Country Director and management team as a strategic P&O partner. You will help shape the organisation, leadership and employee experience needed to deliver the business plan, including organisational change, talent and performance, recruitment and onboarding, leadership development and engagement.

For our Retail organisation, you will ensure that the P&O team provides relevant and effective support to our stores and retail leaders. This includes strengthening the P&O services, processes and guidance available to stores, particularly within employee relations, employee experience and core people processes.

Across both areas, you will lead and develop the local P&O team, including payroll and connect Louis Nielsen with the wider Northern Europe P&O organisation, translating regional and global priorities into locally relevant delivery.

Your key responsibilities

Partnering with our Support Office:

• Partner with the Country Director and management team to shape and deliver the people agenda and local business plan.

• Advise and coach leaders on organisation, leadership, talent, performance and people-related matters.

• Lead organisational change and support leaders and colleagues through change.

• Ensure strong recruitment and onboarding, talent and performance processes, and development planning across the Support Office.

• Drive employee engagement, including Great Place to Work, action planning and follow-up.

Enabling our Retail organisation:

• Ensure that retail leaders and stores have access to relevant and effective P&O services and support.

• Support the continued development and delivery of HR services to stores, including employee relations and employee experience guidance.

• Ensure that core people processes and policies are practical, consistent and effective within our retail environment.

• Work closely with retail leadership to identify emerging people needs and translate them into appropriate P&O solutions.

Leading P&O and connecting with Northern Europe:

• Lead and develop the local P&O team, including payroll, creating clarity, capability and strong delivery.

• Represent Denmark within the Northern Europe P&O team and contribute to the Northern Europe People Plan.

• Translate relevant regional and global people priorities into strong local delivery.

• Partner with regional P&O colleagues across business partnering, learning and development, and operational excellence.

• Lead and contribute to cross-functional projects in Denmark and across Northern Europe.

Your new team

You'll lead the Danish People & Organisation team of six people while being part of the wider Northern Europe P&O function.

The team supports two distinct parts of Louis Nielsen: our Support Office and our nationwide retail organisation. The nature of that support differs, and an important part of your role will be ensuring that our P&O model meets the needs of both.

Within the Support Office, the team works closely with leaders and colleagues across the full employee lifecycle. For Retail, the focus is on providing scalable, effective P&O services, processes and guidance that enable our retail leaders and stores to succeed. You will also collaborate closely with colleagues across the Northern Europe P&O function.

What are we looking for?

“We are looking for someone who genuinely cares about our people, builds trust, and understands everyday life in our stores and Support Office. Someone who offers practical support and keeps things simple and efficient, freeing up time for meaningful conversations, development and looking ahead. You’ll help shape the people agenda in Denmark—and I look forward to working alongside you and our colleagues across Northern Europe, sharing ideas and supporting one another.”_

- Malene Green Brostrøm, People Director Northern Europe

Preferably our candidates will have some of the following competencies:

• Significant HR leadership experience within a complex, matrix organisation.

• Experience acting as a strategic People partner to senior business leaders.

• Experience balancing strategic business partnering with the delivery of scalable and effective HR services across different employee populations.

• A strong track record of leading organisational change and transformation initiatives.

• Experience linking business strategy, people priorities, and employee engagement outcomes.

• Experience working within an international environment.

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, coaching, and influencing skills.

• Strong leadership experience with a proven ability to develop high-performing teams.

• The ability to move comfortably between strategic business partnering and ensuring strong, pragmatic P&O delivery.

It would be an advantage if you have:

• Experience within retail, consumer goods, or other customer-facing multi-site environments.

• Experience working across multiple countries or markets.

• Knowledge of employment relations and organisational change programmes.

• Experience leading cross-functional projects in an international organisation.

As a person, we believe that you are:

• An inspiring leader who develops and motivates others.

• A trusted advisor who builds credibility and strong relationships at all levels.

• Commercially minded and able to connect people priorities with business performance.

• Structured and resilient, with the ability to navigate complexity and change.

• A collaborative communicator who engages stakeholders across functions and geographies.

What awaits you upon joining Louis Nielsen

At Louis Nielsen and Specsavers, you'll get more than just a job. You'll join an organisation with a clear purpose: changing lives through better sight and hearing.

We offer an exciting and influential leadership role where you'll play a key part in shaping the future of our people agenda in Denmark.

Joining us, you’ll get:

• Competitive compensation and benefits.

• Significant exposure to senior business leaders and strategic decision-making.

• An international and collaborative work environment.

• The chance to make a meaningful impact on both people and business performance.

• A culture built on trust, inclusion, and continuous development.

Your base will be at Louis Nielsen’s Support Office in Aalborg, but we take a very flexible approach to where you work. Finding the right person matters more to us than where in Denmark you live. You should, however, expect to spend a couple of days in Aalborg each week.

Is this your next step? Then apply today

To apply, please send us your CV using the button below. We want to respect your time, so including an application letter is optional. Feel free to apply as soon as possible. Please avoid including any photos or references to your age in your CV. It contributes to a fairer and more unbiased assessment.

We review CVs and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis. Our recruitment process typically consists of an initial screening, two rounds of interviews, and a personality assessment feedback session.

Diversity & Inclusion at Specsavers

Specsavers will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected factor.

In line with our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, we integrate these principles into all aspects of our work, from product development to team building.

jobs.occupation: HSO International - Dynamics 365 F&O Finance Lead Consultant
jobs.description:
Position: Dynamics 365 F&O Finance Lead Consultant

Department: Dynamics 365 F&O UO

Visa Sponsorship: You must have legal working rights in the country of your residence within the European region. Sponsorship is only available within the Netherlands.

**About HSO

**HSO is a global business transformation partner where innovation, AI, and Microsoft technology come together. With 30+ years of Microsoft expertise, 3,000 employees worldwide, 2,000+ clients, and 7,500+ projects delivered, we help organizations unlock the full potential of the Microsoft Cloud.

Recognized as a Microsoft AI Business Solutions Inner Circle Partner for 22 consecutive years and a Microsoft Frontier Partner, HSO is among the top Microsoft partners driving AI-powered transformation worldwide.

**About HSO International

**At HSO International, you'll join a diverse team of 300+ professionals representing more than 50 nationalities. We deliver cross-border transformation programs for international customers, combining local expertise with global reach in a culture built on collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.

Learn more about Life at HSO International: Life at HSO International

**The Opportunity

**As a D365 Finance Lead Consultant, you work with Microsoft Dynamics 365, the Azure cloud platform, and our unique, industry-specific solutions to develop the best strategy for a digital transformation and design, implement, and manage innovative cloud solutions for our customers. You will lead the Finance workstream of a complex multinational Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations transformation.

**What You’ll Do

****Lead Finance Transformation

**

• Lead the Finance workstream across international Dynamics 365 programs.

• Advise Finance leaders and key stakeholders on processes, operating models, and technology decisions.

• Lead discovery and design workshops, challenge existing processes, and identify opportunities for standardization, automation, and efficiency.

**Own Finance Solution Design

**

• Own functional design across Dynamics 365 Finance, including General Ledger, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Asset lease, PMA, Revenue recognition, Cost management, Electronic reporting, E-invoicing, Cash & Bank, Budgeting, Credit & Collections, financial reporting and multi-country localizations.

• Ensure Finance solutions work across countries, legal entities, and business units.

• Partner with Solution Architects and other workstreams across integrations, data, testing, and deployment.

**Lead the Workstream

**

• Guide Finance consultants on priorities, dependencies, risks, and key decisions.

• Act as a senior point of contact for the customer Finance team.

• Mentor consultants and maintain quality across Finance deliverables.

**Create Impact Beyond Delivery

**

• Support presales engagements, workshops, and demonstrations.

• Contribute to HSO Finance methodologies, accelerators, and best practices.

• Identify opportunities to apply Copilot, AI, automation, Power Platform, and analytics to Finance transformation.

**What We’re Looking For

**

• At least 10 years of ERP consulting experience with significant Finance expertise.

• Several years of experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations and multi-industry project experience.

• Experience leading a Finance workstream or taking senior functional ownership on complex implementations.

• Strong Finance process, workshop facilitation, solution design, and stakeholder management skills.

• Experience with international or enterprise-scale transformations and mentoring consultants.

• Familiarity with Power Platform, Azure, analytics, automation, AI, Copilot, and the wider Microsoft ecosystem.

• Strong English communication skills and a collaborative, commercially minded approach.

**What You’ll Gain

**

• Global impact: lead Finance transformation across countries, regions, legal entities, and business units.

• Leadership: take greater ownership while remaining close to Finance, technology, and delivery.

• Freedom: influence solution direction and shape your role around your strengths.

• Innovation: help define how AI, automation, and Copilot change Finance and consulting delivery.

Corti builds AI for critical industries. We started in healthcare, where messy inputs, specialized knowledge, and consequential errors make demanding engineering problems unavoidable. Today we train and post-train models, build agents, and turn research into APIs that developers use to build their products. Our platform supports more than one million production interactions every week.

We are building Europe’s alternative to closed AI: ambitious model development, published research, and AI infrastructure that gives developers control over the systems they depend on.

Our platform and APIs provide the building blocks for specialized intelligence that organizations own:

• 
Models: frontier and open-weight models with reasoning, tool calling, structured output, and embeddings through an OpenAI-compatible interface, plus custom models trained and post-trained on an organization’s own data.

• 
Sovereign compute: GPU capacity on Corti-operated European infrastructure for teams that need their data and workloads to stay in Europe.

• 
Agents: a harness to build, evaluate, and optimize agents that connect to real systems, with planning, tool use, external knowledge, persistent context, human approval, and observable execution.

• 
Speech: live dictation, conversational transcription, and batch audio processing.

• 
Clinical documentation: fact extraction as conversations unfold, and document generation with explicit schemas and controllable synthesis.

• 
Medical coding: code predictions from clinical narratives, linked to supporting passages.

Explore the platform at docs.corti.ai.

The Role

You want to train models at the frontier, and you want the science in the open, where other engineers can inspect it. At Corti, you don't have to choose.

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer in our Applied AI team, you drive large-scale training and post-training alongside researchers and engineers. Your decisions span the training recipe, the evaluation, and the system that serves the result. The calls are consequential, and you stay close enough to the implementation to understand why they succeed or fail.

What You Will Do

• 
Designing and running distributed training, including architecture, data pipelines, parallelism, checkpointing, evaluation, and recovery.

• 
Improving model capabilities through supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and distillation.

• 
Finding the causes of unstable training, inefficient communication, poor utilization, and unexpected regressions.

• 
Developing models for agentic work: choosing tools, using evidence, maintaining context, and completing complex tasks reliably.

• 
Building evaluations that expose failure modes and establish whether an improvement holds outside the training distribution, including LLM-as-judge systems you build and calibrate

• 
Creating and curating training data, including synthetic data pipelines that feed real training runs.

• 
Turning stronger models into practical APIs by improving latency, throughput, memory use, and serving cost.

Which capabilities belong in the weights, and which need tools or retrieval? You help decide, and you build the experiments that establish the answer.

Put the science where engineers can inspect it

We believe engineers should be able to examine the methods and evidence behind the systems they build on. We publish research, release benchmark resources, and document how our platform works. Read the work behind our clinical APIs: corti.ai/research

Who you are

You have depth and an urge to experiment

• 
You have trained large language models and owned technically complex ML work. You can explain a difficult run in detail: the architecture, the bottleneck, the failed hypothesis, and the evidence that changed your mind.

• 
You bring strong practical distributed-training experience, and depth in areas such as mixture-of-experts models, reinforcement learning, or distillation. Experience serving open-weight models is a plus. You write code other engineers can build on and make technical trade offs clear.

You know post-training methods from the inside.Preference optimisation and reinforcement learning have quirks, reward hacking, runs that look stable until they collapse, and signals that turns out to be noise. You have hit these problems and learned to spot them before they cost you a week.

You have hands-on experience with the data the models learn from. You have built training-data pipelines, ideally synthetic ones, and stayed close to the training that consumed your data.

You have evaluated LLMs in production. You have built and calibrated LLM-as-judge systems to automate that evaluation, and you know when a judge's score means something and when it just flatters the model it is scoring.

You also have the itch to investigate. A new model, paper, or agent framework appears, and you want to understand what actually changed. You build experiments, compare approaches, and test the claims. Perhaps your latest side project involves agents building tools, coordinating with other agents, or failing in a surprisingly instructive way. We want to hear about it.
